Pure-Python libraries bundled with PlaneSite (loaded only by Publish to GitHub):
  dulwich 1.2.20  - git in Python (Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later), https://www.dulwich.io
  urllib3 2.8.0   - HTTP client used by dulwich (MIT), https://urllib3.readthedocs.io
They live here, inside the app folder, so the in-app update delivers them; nothing is installed.
